## Sources and conventions

Five treatments were harvested: [Judson Chapter 17](https://math.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Abstract_and_Geometric_Algebra/Abstract_Algebra%3A_Theory_and_Applications_%28Judson%29/17%3A_Polynomials), [Donaldson §§22–23](https://www.math.uci.edu/~ndonalds/math120b/2poly.pdf), [McKernan Lecture 21](https://opencw.aprende.org/courses/mathematics/18-703-modern-algebra-spring-2013/lecture-notes/MIT18_703S13_pra_l_21.pdf), [Keith Conrad](https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/ringtheory/irredtestsoverQ.pdf), and [Brian Conrad](https://math.stanford.edu/~conrad/210BPage/handouts/sepfield.pdf).

Conventions reconciled include undefined degree for zero, sequence versus trimmed-list polynomials, formal polynomials versus polynomial functions, unital homomorphisms, evaluation through a coefficient map, undefined polynomial \(\gcd(0,0)\), nonzero-nonunit irreducibility, and integer-form Eisenstein. No applied canonical-embedding notation occurs in the artifacts.
